title: Arthur's own brief drumming with Fats Pichon
summary: Arthur played drums briefly with Fats Pichon's first band and tried clarinet but lost interest.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: You never wanted to take up music? Did you ever play any of that? Yeah I played music.

Oh you did? I played drum. You didn't play drums? But not too long. I played drum with Fat Pichon when we were young kids. When he first started his little band up, I played drum with him, several little house parties. But I never did like music. And my oldest brother, he was teaching me clarinet, the one that got killed. Oh yeah. And I took that up for a while, then I gave that up. I didn't like, I just didn't go for music.
Did your father ever help you with drums or did you start after that?

No, I started after him. In other words there was a friend of ours, a boy by the name of Louis Duguay. And he had a set of drums that he played with Fat Pichon. But in the meantime he wasn't so hot. And I don't know if I just had a feel for music at the time but I used to play with him and practice with him. And I could beat the drums better than he did. So when they get these boys instead of him playing I play the job. That's how I started playing. But I didn't play too long, you know I don't doubt if I played two years. I doubt if I played two years with them. But I beat on them drums a lot, I had a lot of kick out of it. But I just couldn't put my mind up to be a musician. That's all. I just didn't go for it. I had a sister that was, oh she was much older than I am. We got about, let's see, one, two. Yeah, two other sisters between her and I. She died at the age of 33. And she played piano pretty fair. Yeah, but she's never taken any job. But just for her entertaining she played piano pretty nice.
